units.source_text: 播洒炫目太阳光的夏天，只有在小说和电影中才会出现。

en.t: Summers scattering dazzling sunlight appear only in novels and films.

units.source_text: 现实里所有的只是谨小慎微的星期天：

en.t: In reality, all there is are timid, cautious Sundays:

units.source_text: 把报纸上硝烟弥漫的政治栏垫在屁股底下睡觉……

en.t: sleeping with the newspaper's smoke-filled political column spread under one's backside...

units.source_text: 盖子上缀着磁石的热水瓶和罐装汽水……

en.t: a thermos with a magnet fixed to its lid, and canned soda...

units.source_text: 排长队才能弄到手的、一小时一百五十日元的租用艇，

en.t: rental boats that cost one hundred fifty yen an hour and can only be had after standing in a long line,

units.source_text: 以及波浪中涌出死鱼尸体的铅色泡沫……

en.t: and lead-colored foam that spews the bodies of dead fish out of the waves...

units.source_text: 那么，最后就该是充斥疲劳的满员列车了……

en.t: Then, at the end, there would have to be a packed train filled with exhaustion...

units.source_text: 谁都清楚那种事，只是不想做自欺欺人的傻瓜罢了。

en.t: Everyone knows that sort of thing; they simply do not want to be fools who deceive themselves and others.

units.source_text: 在那灰色的画布上，他们拼命涂抹，模仿幻之祭典。

en.t: On that gray canvas, they smear paint desperately, imitating an imagined festival.

units.source_text: 为了让别人说一句“愉快的星期天”，

en.t: In order to make someone say, "What a pleasant Sunday,"

units.source_text: 满脸邋遢胡子的父亲，连推带搡地轰走死缠硬磨的孩子……

en.t: a father with a face covered in scruffy stubble shoves and hustles away a child who keeps clinging and pestering him...

units.source_text: 电气列车角落里小小的风景谁都见过一次……

en.t: Everyone has seen that little scene in the corner of an electric train at least once...

units.source_text: 对于他人的太阳，表现出令人同情的焦虑与嫉妒……

en.t: showing a pitiable anxiety and jealousy toward someone else's sun...
